name: Drywall (gypsum board)
description: Paper-faced gypsum board in 4x8 sheets for interior walls and ceilings: 1/2in regular, or 5/8in Type X where a fire-rated assembly is needed (e.g. a wall or ceiling between a garage and living space). Not for tub surrounds or other wet areas; use cement board there.
source: National Gypsum Gold Bond data sheet (hosted by Home Depot/Lowe's): 1/2in regular 1.3-1.4 lb/sq ft (about 520 kg/m3); USG Sheetrock Firecode X submittal: 5/8in Type X 2.2 lb/sq ft nominal (about 677 kg/m3). 600 kg/m3 is a midpoint for both thicknesses.

name: Cement backer board (1/2in)
description: Cement backer board, 1/2in in 3x5 sheets, screwed to studs as the base for tile in tub surrounds and other wet areas. Needs a waterproofing membrane over it where it gets soaked.
source: USG Durock Cement Board Technical Notes and ASTM-verified EPD: 1/2in 2.4 psf (x 4.88243). HardieBacker 1/2in is similar (Lowe's lists 39 lb per 3x5 sheet, about 2.6 psf).

name: Interior latex paint
description: Water-based acrylic latex wall paint, priced per sq ft of wall covered by one coat (a gallon covers about 250-400 sq ft). Plan on primer plus two coats over new drywall.
source: Estimate: Behr Premium Plus Interior Eggshell No. 2050 technical data sheet (rev 05/25): 11.0 lb/gal, 54% solids by weight, so about 5.9 lb of dry film per gallon; at 400 sq ft/gal that is about 0.015 psf (0.072 kg/m2) per coat.

name: Exterior acrylic paint
description: 100% acrylic exterior house paint, priced per sq ft covered by one coat (a gallon covers about 250-400 sq ft). Rough siding takes more.
source: Estimate: no dry-film weight published. Assumed similar to Behr Premium Plus interior latex (11.0 lb/gal, 54% solids by weight per its technical data sheet), about 0.015 psf per coat at 400 sq ft/gal; coverage 250-400 sq ft/gal from Behr Premium Plus Exterior product pages.

name: Exterior wood stain
description: Semi-transparent or solid exterior wood stain and sealer for siding, fences and decks, priced per sq ft covered by one coat (about 250-350 sq ft per gallon on the first coat). Recoat every few years.
source: Estimate: stain soaks into the wood and leaves a thin film; no weight published. About 0.006 psf assumed (low-solids stain at roughly 300 sq ft/gal). Coverage from Behr Premium Semi-Transparent Waterproofing Stain & Sealer (250-300 sq ft/gal first coat) and Olympic Elite Solid (350 sq ft/gal) product pages.
